question.question:
Use exact arithmetic. An all-equity firm has unlevered value 1060 USD million. At the start of year 1 it issues 350 USD million of debt at par and spends all proceeds repurchasing shares. Interest at 5.5 percent per year accrues on the balance at the beginning of each year, is paid at year end and is fully deductible at a 23 percent corporate tax rate. A principal repayment of 50 USD million is paid from operating cash at the end of each of years 1 through 4; the balance left after the year-4 repayment is held permanently (inputs leaving a non-positive balance are invalid). Discount each annual shield at the debt rate; once permanent, the shield value equals the tax rate times that balance as of that date. Debt market value equals 350 USD million. Report equity value immediately after the repurchase.

Answer format: use exact arithmetic through all intermediate steps, round only the final value half up to 4 decimal digits, and return only the numeric value interpreted in `usd_million` with no unit label or additional text.

Present value of interest tax shields during the scheduled repayment years only
Total present value of the debt tax shield at the issue date
